description: List opportunities — the enquiries, drafts, quotations and orders for a rental job — with their dates, state and charge totals. Free-text search covers subject, description, number, customer name and tags. filtermode e.g. live, all, inactive, enquiries, drafts, quotations, orders, invoiced, not_invoiced, needing_prep. Line items are NOT included here: use current_rms_get_opportunity or current_rms_list_opportunity_items. Max 25 per page. Current RMS: GET /opportunities.

filtermode.description: Built-in filter, e.g. live, all, quotations, orders, not_invoiced.

filters.description: Extra Current RMS query-engine predicates, sent as q[<key>]=<value> (arrays become q[<key>][]). Examples: {"updated_at_gt": "2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"}, {"number_eq": "003664"}, {"status_not_eq": 40}, {"work_email_address_eq": "abc@test.com"}, {"asset_number_eq": "ABC-1"}. Unknown predicates are silently ignored by the API.

include.description: Associations to embed in each record.

search.description: Free-text search on subject, description, number, customer name or tags.

sort.description: Sort order, e.g. ["name asc"] or ["updated_at desc", "id asc"]. Add "id asc" when paging so the order is deterministic.

view_id.description: Record id of a saved custom view to apply.

name: current_rms_list_opportunities
title: List opportunities
